szoveg_eredeti:
Introducing OpenWorks, our program to fund local AI experts to help small businesses grow their business with AI.

AI is accelerating small business, lowering the barriers to entry (I've been increasingly hearing from people who left their job to start a small business because they have AI tools to support them) and helping them earn more.

join us. https://openai.com/openworks
